title: When the Wardrobe Turns
author: Theo Sandoval
blurb: Kestrel Ishikawa, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
